lines.trans: How could it be Xie Ling? Even if the boss did not return, they should have hired someone reliable!
Back at ME, he always treated the boss as an imaginary enemy and made life hard for him everywhere.
Unable to beat the boss professionally, he played dirty tricks in office politics instead.
In the end he even exploited the boss's breakup with Luo Lin, turning the company toxic.

words.gram: Meaning: make a huge fuss over.

lines.trans: In the years since the boss joined Xingtian, he tried every trick yet never won a single round.
Last year he even planted informants here and spent money to poach our artists.

words.gloss: snatch a deal or talent away at the last moment

lines.trans: When someone tried to snatch Yin Zhengyu away from us back then, was that his doing?
Who else could it possibly have been!
To undermine the boss, there was no underhanded stunt he would not pull.
And now look at him, marching straight in here to pick the ripe apples the boss planted!
Has the man got no shame at all?
Just look how smug he is—how could we ever swallow this insult?
